vibe.verdict: A cosy Amish barn supper, but Kingpin's loud bowling alley comedy and Big Ern are barely there, and the Western style type clashes.
missing: Roy milking the "cow" that turns out to be a bull
Ishmael ordering coffee extra large with lots of cream
Big Ern McCracken's "gravy train with biscuit wheels" line
The Trojan deal that made Roy "The Rubber Man"
ideas: Swap "Farmyard vanilla malt milkshake" for "Ishmael's extra large coffee, lots of cream".
Add "Gravy train with biscuit wheels" (biscuits and gravy) in place of the pot roast note.
Swap the saloon style headings for a bowling alley look: lane stripes and a ball return.
Rename "Fresh farm milk" note to "Roy milked it himself. Ask who he thought it was."
